title: ci(console-pin-gate): the spec-injection check reads only exports-map entry files, so since #25748's shared chunks it counts nearly every spec description as pin-only — main red
body:
Filing gate: **① main red** (schedule `CI`, 2026-10-25 16:00Z, `abebc4e14d`: job `Console Pin Gate` 121217997403). Filed by the triage seat (`session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: the 18.2.0 release gate (`scheduled-full-run.mjs --release-gate`) reads the newest schedule run at or before the version commit, so a red schedule `CI` holds the cut. The red is the gate's own measurement, not a console defect.
Reader: `domain:devx`, `scripts/console-spec-probes.mjs`. One small PR, with a pin test.

## Measured (job log 121217997403)
- objectui `b41ed7f68956` built. Console `tsc` and `vite build` passed, the `import/jobs` canary passed, and the single-zod canary passed.
- `scripts/assert-console-spec-injection.mjs` then failed: "Built console still carries the @objectstack/spec of objectui's own build of objectstack 47af3dde42bb … (3086 of 4405 pin-only descriptions)". The first one is " (24h); the day column starts here and runs 24h. Renderer default ".
- The same log shows the injection itself worked. `OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST` is the framework checkout's `packages/spec`, "21 exports entries aliased", and `@objectstack/spec@file:.objectstack-pin/spec` was re-packed from `abebc4e14d`.

## Cause (read from code on `main` `abebc4e14d`; not yet run locally)
`readSpecBlob()` in `scripts/console-spec-probes.mjs` (~line 67) concatenates only the files the package's `exports` map resolves to.

Since #25748 (`3a2d38c6e2`, merged 14:33Z, first in schedule `CI` at 16:00Z), the framework spec's entry files are thin re-exports, and the schema bodies (with their `.describe()` text) live in `dist/chunk-HASH.{mjs,js}`. The framework-side blob therefore lacks almost every description. Meanwhile the pin's per-entry spec (`47af3dde42bb`, before #25748) still carries them all inline. So "text only the vendored spec has" becomes almost the whole description set, and the bundle, which carries the framework's chunks with the same text, matches 3086 of them.

The last green schedule `CI` (15:00Z, `5e7cf63e71`) did not yet contain `3a2d38c6e2`.

## Done when
- `readSpecBlob` reads the whole built JS graph the exports map reaches: every relative import it follows, or every `dist/**/*.{js,mjs,cjs}` under the package. Chunk names are unstable by design, so it must not name them.
- A pin test covers a fixture spec whose entries re-export from a chunk: chunk-held text counts as the published spec, not as pin-only.
- `Console Pin Gate` is green on the next schedule `CI`.

## Notes
- PR #25827 (ui-merge epic) retires this gate. It has not merged, and main must be green before the 18.2.0 cut, so the fix lands now. Once the gate is retired, the fix becomes a no-op.
- Not a flake: the same check will fail every schedule run until fixed.
- Dedupe: no open card names this check since 15:55Z. Repo-scoped listing, because search is unreachable from the seat.
